The sea hums softly in the dark,
A silver tide beneath the stars.
It pulls the sand from shore to shore,
And carries dreams the world once bore.

No two waves are shaped the same—
Each one a song, each one a name.
Yet all return, as if they knew:
The endless road leads back to you.
